name: stracer-report-generator
description: Indoor Report desktop generator built with Next.js and Tauri.

scripts.build:backend: dotnet publish backend\SignalTracker.Api\SignalTracker.Api.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o backend-publish /p:PublishSingleFile=true /p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build:backend && tauri build --bundles nsis
